hero.subtitle: Plug Dropbox login into your app with one shared Code Exchange flow for web and mobile.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Dropbox uses the OAuth2 Authorization Code flow. After consent, the API calls users/get_current_account, creates a short-lived single-use exchange code in Redis, and your client exchanges it for the same JWTs you get from password login. Scope account_info.read is sufficient for login.

console.title: Dropbox App Console
console.description: Create an app in the Dropbox App Console → set OAuth2 Redirect URI to DROPBOX_CALLBACK_URL and enable scope account_info.read.

api.title: API contract
api.description: The API exposes a start URL and a callback that issues the exchange code.

codeHeader.label: Start
codeHeader.context: Redirect the user to Dropbox consent

codeHeader.label: Callback
codeHeader.context: Dropbox redirects back to the API

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: The Dropbox account_id from get_current_account is stored as dropboxId. Email and name come from the account profile when account_info.read scope is granted.
